name: The most AI-assisted indoor grow controller
asks: i want you to work with 3 sonnet engineers and 2 haiku researchers to extend our science, engineering, and operations, related to cannabis, finding cannabis, and, running a small 8 plant indoor grow, specifically for helping us do that in MN: we want the most AI assisted grow we can possibly imagine, next-gen nonsense,. since we have so much agent stuff anyway. Go hard on this work

x-provenance.recorded-by: program-manager (bare-cedar-fog-claude, dispatched under the Leader standing direction of 2026-10-09)
x-provenance.basis: Opening prompt of the Leader on Bare Cedar Fog, carried as a requirement record by the board-requirement-intake skill. The raised-by field and asks are the Leader's own words; the requirements below are the program manager's EARS rendering of what those words ask, and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: An unbranded, household-agnostic indoor-grow controller holds a grow inside the setpoints the research states, with agents proposing and a MAPE-K loop deciding.

requirements.says: The indoor-grow controller shall hold monitored environment variables inside the setpoint bands that a cultivation research record supplies as data.
requirements.rationale: Science supplies setpoints; engineering is the toolbox (science -> engineering -> operations).

requirements.says: The indoor-grow controller shall run on the Group's MAPE-K engine and carry no loop of its own.
requirements.rationale: Rule use-and-improve-the-groups-own-software; the receiving verdict on #49 found a bespoke loop.

requirements.says: The indoor-grow controller shall carry no household's jurisdiction, retailer or device data in its source.
requirements.rationale: Rule science-engineering-operations-parameterize-in-order: no engineering resource carries a particular section's data.

requirements.says: Where an agent proposes a change to a setpoint or a schedule, the indoor-grow controller shall record the proposal with its evidence and the loop's decision on it.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "the most AI assisted grow we can possibly imagine"; recorded proposals are what makes agent assistance auditable.

conditions.says: The controller exists as a package.
The package depends on the MAPE-K engine package.
The package has source and no data directory.
A test exercises recorded agent proposals.

board-opening.context: The Leader names three layers (science, engineering, operations), so the ask is three requests in the order science, engineering, operations. The staffing sentence ("3 sonnet engineers and 2 haiku researchers") is not a requirement and is left out by the intake skill. Pull request red-cup-engineering/computer-services-section#49 ("Control a home grow autonomically and find what to grow") was judged "evacuate" on 2026-10-09: its one household's Minnesota data and its bespoke MAPE-K loop belong in science and operations and in the Group's MAPE-K engine, not in a generic engineering repository (note on receiving the open pull requests, line 118 and 310).

Go hard on this work

x-provenance.not-held: No package is landed. On 2026-10-10 the grow-assist pass judged #49 part by part (re-homing note), found no MAPE-K engine package in the house, and carried #49's capabilities as requirements in indoor-grow-autonomic-control.json; the household's data is in personal-minnesota-indoor-cannabis-grow-services-section/data/records.
x-provenance.unresolved-authority: Pull request #49 is judged "evacuate" and awaits the CEngO's receiving duty; this requirement does not decide it.
